verses.text: Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, maklejek eyab' tas swala', yujto in chekab' ex, sik'b'il ex el wuuj.
Ha in Jehová in tik ix ex in b'o'o ayik manto ex alji, a in tzin kolwaj heyet'ok. Manh ex xiw ex aj Jesurún, ex yinhtilal Jacob, in chekab' ex, sik'b'il ex el wuuj.
Yujto ol wak'el yok ha ha' t'a takinh lu'um, ol b'ey ha' t'a lum takinh sat. Ol wak'och Wespíritu t'a heb' eyinhtilal, ol wak'an in wach'k'olal t'a heb'.
Icha wal sq'uib' anh ank'ultak ayoch yalil, icha chi' ol aj sq'uib' heb'. Icha sq'uib' te' b'akmam t'a stitak ha ha' sb'eyi, icha chi' ol aj heb'.

Ha t'a skal heb', ay mach ol halan icha tik: Ha in tik, yik in Jehová, xchama. Ay pax mach ol halan icha tik: Yinhtilal in Jacob, xchama. Ay pax mach ol tz'ib'anoch t'a sk'ab' icha tik: Yik in wal Jehová, xchama. Ol yak'anoch Israel sjolomok sb'i, xchi Jehová.
Ha Jehová Rey, Skolumal Israel, Yajal t'a Smasanil, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ton b'ab'el waj t'a smasanil, slajwub' in paxi. Ha innhej Dios in, malaj junokxo.

¿Mach wal junok lajan wet'ok? Tato ay, lolonokab'i, yalokab' t'ayin tas yaji. ¿Tokwal ay junokxo mach ayokto yalannakkani tastak ujinak yet' tas toto ol ujok? Tato ay, yalokab'i tas toto ol ujok chi'.
Manh ex xiwok, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a. Ha ex tik in testigo ex to walnak juntzanh tik t'a pekataxo. ¿Tokwal ay junokxo Dios ma junokxo kolwajwum? Ha innhej toni, malaj junokxo wojtak, xchi Jehová.

Ha wal heb' sb'oan yechel juntzanh komon Dios, malaj jab'ok yelk'och heb'. Malaj pax jab'ok yelk'och juntzanh yechel komon Dios xajanej heb' chi'. Ha heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios chi', max ujilaj yilan heb', malaj spensar heb'. Yuj chi' q'uixwelal ol ajkan heb' yuj.
Ha heb' sb'oan junok yechel komon Dios yet' k'een k'een, tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay, Dios yalan heb', palta nab'anhej syixtej sb'a heb'.

Masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel chi', ol q'uixwokkan heb', yujto a heb' sb'oan juntzanh yechel chi', animanhej heb'. Tato smolb'ej sb'a heb' smasanil t'a wichanh yik tzin ch'olb'itan heb', ol q'uixwok wal heb', ol xiwkank'e heb'.

Ileknab'i, a winh b'oum k'een, syik'kot k'een syamk'ab' winh, haxo yik toxo ix chakxil k'een k'een chi' t'a kal k'ak', stenan k'een winh yet' k'een martillo yik stojolb'ioch yechel chi'. Yet' wal yip sk'ab' winh stenani. Palta tato malaj tas swa winh, tz'och swejel winh, stakjipax sti' winh, tz'el yip winh.

Ileknab'pax junok winh nhikum te' sb'oan junok yechel: Syechtej te' winh yet' junok echlab', syak'anoch yechel te' winh yet' te' slápiz yet' jun tz'ak'anoch yechel, setan setan tz'aji. Syamanoch winh smunlaj yet' k'een tz'ukub'. Icha chi' tz'aj sb'oan jun yechel chi' winh, icha anima wach' yilji, icha chi' tz'ajelk'ochi. Slajwi chi' syak'anoch winh t'a yol spat.

Ha junok winh nhikum te' chi', sb'at winh sch'ak te' k'ute', ma te' tzikap, ma te' ji, haton te' sq'uib' t'a kaltak te'. Mato jun, syawej junok te' taj winh, haxo nhab' tz'ik'an sq'uib' te'. Niwan tz'aj te' yik wach' sb'o komon Dios chi' t'a te'.

Haton t'a te' tz'elta te' sk'atzitz winh, syak'anoch sk'ak' winh yet' te' b'aj sk'axni. Sb'oanpax swael winh yet' te' k'ak' chi'. Haxo yet' jab'okxo te', sb'o junok yechel sdiosal winh, tz'och ijan winh yoch ejmelal t'ay.

Haton yet' te' k'atzitz chi' syak'och sk'ak' winh, sb'olan schib'ej winh, swa winh, sb'ut'ji wal winh sik'lab'il yuj sb'olb'il chib'ej chi'. Sk'axni winh t'a te', syalan winh icha tik: Te wach' in aj in q'uixnaj t'a ti k'ak' tik, xchi winh.
Haxo yet' jab'okxo te' skan chi', sb'oanpax junok yechel skomon diosal winh, tz'och ijan winh yem nhojan ejmelal t'ay. Stewioch winh t'ay icha tik: Kol in, yujto in diosal ach, xchi winh t'a te'.
Ha wal juntzanh anima chi', malaj spensar heb', max nachaj jab'ok yuj heb'. Makan sat heb', max uji yilan heb', makan spensar heb', max nachaj yuj heb'.

Manh chamok snaan heb', max nachaj jab'ok yuj heb', max yal heb' icha tik: Ha t'a nanhalxo te te' tik ix wak'och in k'ak', ix wak'an k'anb'ok in pan, ix in b'olpax in chib'ej t'a stzak'aq'uil te', ix in wa'i. Manh smojok tzin b'o junok yechel komon Dios yajb'entak yet' jab'okxo te' tik. Manh smojok tzin och ejmelal t'a jun te' yib' te' tik, manh xchiok jab'ok heb'.

Ha heb' icha chi' sk'ulej, ichato a k'een tik'aq'uil taanh slo heb'. Juwinakel spensar heb', satnak heb', manh ol yal skolan sb'a heb'. Manh naanok yalan heb' icha tik: Ha tas b'ob'il yuj in k'ab' tik, nab'a esnhej, manh xchiok heb'.
Ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, naekkoti to in chekab' ex, a in in b'onak ex yik tzex och in chekab'ok, mokab' in b'at satk'olal eyuuj.
Ha in ix in satel he paltail icha satem yal ak'wal. Ix in satel he mul icha wal tz'aj satem asun. Kotanhekxi t'ayin, yujto ix ex in kolo', xchi Jehová.

Ha satchanh, elokab' yaw sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yuj tas ix sk'ulej Jehová. Ha niwak jul t'a sat lu'um tik, awajokab'i. Ha lum niwak witz yet' lum tzalkixtak, b'itanokab' lu'um t'a tzalajk'olal yujto ix sch'ox stzikikial Jehová ayik ix skolan heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob.

Ha Jehová ko Kolumal tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ton Jehová in, ix ex in b'o'o ayik manto ex alji, a in in b'onak masanil tastak. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha'anh, wak'annakpaxkan em lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, ¿tom ay junokxo mach kolwajnak wet'ok?
Ha in tzin tenek' tas syal heb' ajchum, tzin juanpaxb'at spensar heb' naumel lolonel. Swak'an somchajel spensar heb' aj pensar, skistalaxkan heb' wuuj.

Palta a in swak'elk'och tas syal heb' in chekab', yik wach' tz'ajelk'och tas syal heb' chi'. Ha in swala' to a Jerusalén ol kajnajxok, haxo juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol b'ochajxok t'a yet'tal b'aj juwinakel chi'.
Ha in syal walan t'a ha' mar to stup ha'. Masanil yoktak ha' tz'eli, swak' tupok.

Ha in swal t'a winhaj Ciro icha tik: Ach Ciro, a ach ayach och yilumalok in chonhab'. Ha ach ol a b'o masanil tas tzin nib'ej. Ol halan t'a Jerusalén: Ol ach b'ochajxik'eok, ol ak'chajxiem yich templo, xa chi, xin chi t'a winh, xchi Jehová.
